together.problem: A shelf is 3 feet long. A box is 40 inches long. Does the box fit on the shelf?
together.problemEs: Un estante mide 3 pies de largo. Una caja mide 40 pulgadas de largo. ¿Cabe la caja en el estante?

figure.caption: Start with the fact: 1 foot is 12 inches.
figure.captionEs: Empieza con el dato: 1 pie son 12 pulgadas.

steps.ask: How many inches are in 1 foot?
What scale factor takes 1 foot to 3 feet?

steps.ask: How many inches long is the shelf?
steps.askEs: ¿Cuántas pulgadas de largo mide el estante?

steps.ask: Compare 40 inches and 36 inches. Does the box fit?
steps.askEs: Compara 40 pulgadas y 36 pulgadas. ¿Cabe la caja?
steps.answer: No. 40 > 36, so the box is too long.
steps.answerEs: No. 40 > 36, así que la caja es demasiado larga.

together.answer: The shelf is 36 inches long. 40 > 36, so the box does not fit.
together.answerEs: El estante mide 36 pulgadas. 40 > 36, así que la caja no cabe.

together.problem: A bag of flour has a mass of 2 kilograms. A recipe needs 1,500 grams of flour. Is there enough flour?

steps.ask: Compare 2,000 grams and 1,500 grams. Is there enough flour?
steps.askEs: Compara 2,000 gramos y 1,500 gramos. ¿Hay suficiente harina?

together.answer: 2 kilograms is 2,000 grams. 2,000 > 1,500, so there is enough flour.
together.answerEs: 2 kilogramos son 2,000 gramos. 2,000 > 1,500, así que hay suficiente harina.

steps.ask: How many inches are in 1 foot?

together.answer: The rug is 3.5 feet long. That is the same as 3 feet 6 inches.

steps.answer: A kilometer is much larger than a meter. It takes fewer kilometers to cover the same distance.
steps.answerEs: Un kilómetro es mucho más grande que un metro. Se necesitan menos kilómetros para cubrir la misma distancia.

onMyOwn.problem: Bag A of rice weighs 2 pounds. Bag B weighs 30 ounces. How many more ounces does the heavier bag weigh?

onMyOwn.hint: Write both weights in ounces before you compare. There are 16 ounces in 1 pound.
onMyOwn.hintEs: Escribe los dos pesos en onzas antes de comparar. Hay 16 onzas en 1 libra.

steps.doEs: Resta los dos pesos.

onMyOwn.explain: Why must you convert before you subtract?
onMyOwn.explainEs: ¿Por qué debes convertir antes de restar?
onMyOwn.modelExplanation: 2 and 30 use different units. 2 pounds is 32 ounces, so Bag A is heavier. 32 − 30 = 2, so Bag A weighs 2 ounces more.
onMyOwn.modelExplanationEs: 2 y 30 usan unidades distintas. 2 libras son 32 onzas, así que la bolsa A pesa más. 32 − 30 = 2, así que la bolsa A pesa 2 onzas más.

onMyOwn.explain: Why is 2 feet 6 inches not 2.6 feet?
onMyOwn.explainEs: ¿Por qué 2 pies 6 pulgadas no son 2.6 pies?
onMyOwn.modelExplanation: A foot has 12 inches, not 10. So 6 inches is 6 out of 12, which is half a foot, or 0.5. 2 feet 6 inches is 2.5 feet.
onMyOwn.modelExplanationEs: Un pie tiene 12 pulgadas, no 10. Así que 6 pulgadas son 6 de 12, que es medio pie, o 0.5. 2 pies 6 pulgadas son 2.5 pies.
